An illustration of a traditional Chinese abacus (suanpan) showing a rectangular wooden frame divided by a horizontal beam. The upper deck has two beads per rod; the lower deck has five beads per rod. Some beads are moved towards the centre beam to show a calculated number. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

Illustration of the Jacquard Loom. A large wooden weaving frame. At the top, a continuous loop of heavy cardboard punch cards is feeding into the machine's mechanism, controlling the lifting of warp threads below to weave a pattern. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

A black and white style historical illustration of the ENIAC computer. A massive room filled with towering metal cabinets covered in dials, switches, and thick black cables plugged into various ports like an old telephone exchange. Two operators in 1940s clothing are plugging in patch cables. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
